guardrails.rule: Status claims require proportionate evidence.
Recall relevant project memory before substantive implementation.
Never silently erase historical decisions or useful ideas.
Local improvement must not cause global regression.
A significant capability has one canonical owner.
Reuse/extend/adapter before creating a parallel service.
Inter-service collaboration uses contracts/ports/events, not private-table coupling.
Service dependencies and forbidden responsibilities are explicit.
Orchestration may coordinate but must not bypass domain policy.
Retries must not duplicate side effects.
Uncertain outcomes are not success and are not blindly replayed.
Offline acceptance must not fake remote finality.
Material state changes are auditable.
Secret values never enter repository, docs, logs, or recovery artifacts.
Credentials and service permissions are least-privilege.
Database evolution is additive/expand-first by default.
Substantive risky changes have a rollback or safe base.
Done means code, tests, security, errors, storage/API coherence and required field proof.
Important truth is persisted outside chat for the next agent.
Branch/HEAD/CI/deployment/DB facts are revalidated at source.
Commit, merge, migration, deployment and production approval are distinct.
A substantial checkpoint is incomplete until its restoration path and integrity evidence are testable.
Dynamic truth must be revalidated at Git/CI/DB/production sources before mutation.
